instruction: By straight-line distance, which two of these three sites lie closest to each other: Bauhaus Dessau, Naumburg Cathedral, or the Wartburg? Answer with the two site names.

provenance.source_benchmark: AssistantBench (Yoran et al., 2024); BrowseComp (Wei et al., 2025)
provenance.construction_method: Three site locations retrieved; the closest pair is selected. Parallel, no runtime dependency.
